description: [Afreximbank] Cairo -- African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) is pleased to launch the second season of its documentary series, Impact Stories. Building on the success of the inaugural season, the new collection of six films expands the series' geographic scope to capture the Bank's growing footprint across Global Africa, featuring stories from the Caribbean and Africa.
title: Africa: Beyond the Balance Sheet - Afreximbank Unveils Season II of 'Impact Stories,' Showcasing Transformative Projects Across Two Continents

title: Africa: AGOA Changes Add to Africa's Rollercoaster Ride of U.S. Tariffs

description: [HRW] Violence against women and girls in Africa demands urgent action. As of 2023, it is estimated that one in three women and girls between ages 15 and 49, have experienced physical and/or sexual intimate partner violence in their lifetime. Last November, South Africa classified violence against women as a national disaster.
title: Africa: AU Should Strengthen Its Framework to Curb Violence Against Women

description: [IFEX] On February 10-11, 2026, researchers and experts convened in Dakar, Senegal, for the first Africa Forum on Countering Foreign Interference (CFI). The forum brought together participants from Africa, Europe and America to examine the growing challenge of foreign information manipulation and its implications for governance, media ecosystems, and digital rights across the African continent.
title: Africa: Experts Highlight How Foreign Actors Are Exploiting Weaknesses in Africa's Information Ecosystem to Influence Narratives Around Politics, Trade and Strategic Resources.
